key_insight: ENS replaces residual minimization with residual-conditioned iterative correction, letting the network use its own PDE error field as input to learn better updates.
engineering_relevance: It offers a faster, more stable alternative to hybrid PDE solvers for scientific machine learning, especially when accuracy must hold under distribution shift.
method: Feed the PDE residual field into the solver at each iteration.
Learn an update policy that corrects predictions directly from error structure.
Avoid gradient-descent or Gauss--Newton residual minimization and its instability/compute cost.
evidence_signal: Across four PDE families, the method achieved the highest accuracy in most settings, with gains up to 10× on turbulent Kolmogorov flow and strong zero-shot transfer results.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how well the model is trained to interpret residual patterns, and benefits are likely largest in ill-conditioned regimes rather than universally.
